description: The d1952 stand-in income measure: a person-level, annual, TY2027 NZD statistical measure computed by measure.combine@1 in integer cents. It is not IRD taxable income. Universe: included at x > 0, excluded at x <= 0, unresolved on any null component (R2C-14). The unit column is max(0, x)/100 (R2C-10).

central.description: Design 80 section 3: P1-mapped wages, signed self-employment, interest, dividends, rental profit with losses added back (max(0, r)), and the annual gross JS, SPS, SLP and NZS transfers.

vsi.description: VSI stress test: the central measure without the four transfer addends, with the same flags, payments and entitlement rules.

identity_receipts.description: R2C-29: the exact identities transport.income_identity@1 checks on every record of the central measure in each run, in Python integers with its own arithmetic. It refuses at the first record where one fails and names the identity and the record. It also reports each add-back column's total, which follows from component_sum and carries no identity of its own.

identities.statement: On each record with every component present, the measure equals the sum of each component times its sign plus each add-back column's max(0, -signed value). A record with any null component carries a null measure.
Each resolved record's unit equals max(floor, measure) / scale as the correctly rounded float64, bit for bit. A record with any null component carries a NaN unit.
A record's universe status reads unresolved when any component is null, included when the measure exceeds zero and excluded otherwise.
Each resolved record's exact component sum fits in a signed 64-bit integer.

omission_register.description: Items IRD taxable income contains that the stand-in omits. A size appears only where a repo resource or a cited public source gives one; design 80's percentages are the proposal's claims and carry no source here, so every size reads unknown. Unknown is not zero.

items.reason: The taxable share of private pensions is unknown.
Receipt is unsupported under H4 (receipt_contract.json); the VP rows stay parked.
No trust producer; may overlap other items.
Only self-employment losses and the rental add-back are netted.

review_triggers.description: R2C-3: VSI escalation triggers are review triggers, not gates. When one fires the hub writes a ruling before any release claim. No gate kind computes them yet, so G8-x reports them.

wage_earner_count.comparison: the sum of the 235 IRD P1 wage counts against the model's weighted persons with positive employment_income, before and after the fit
